visualCharacteristics: Photo-led feature grid. Each card has an image on top, then a heading, a short description paragraph, and a call-to-action link. Three cards side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile.
contentPattern: Each row is one card with two cells: an image cell (picture) and a body cell (heading + description + CTA link).
usage: Use for a row of promotional feature cards where each card leads with a photo and links out to a detail page.
